name: ebao-studio
description: Official DeepSeek Harness Desktop with e宝工坊 login and welcome presentation.

scripts.setup: yarn upstream:init && yarn upstream:install && yarn upstream:prepare-electron
scripts.test:launcher: node --test scripts/official-desktop.test.mjs scripts/prepare-cqai-account.test.mjs scripts/prepare-ebao-welcome.test.mjs scripts/prepare-ebao-account-renderer.test.mjs scripts/prepare-ebao-package.test.mjs scripts/verify-release-assets.test.mjs scripts/sync-gitcode-source.test.mjs scripts/sync-gitcode-release.test.mjs
scripts.test: yarn test:launcher && yarn test:integrations && yarn test:desktop
scripts.check: yarn check:layout && yarn check:components && yarn test:launcher && yarn build && yarn typecheck && yarn test:integrations && yarn test:desktop
scripts.cqai:test: cd deepseek-harness && corepack pnpm exec vitest run --config ../integrations/cqai-desktop-account/vitest.config.mjs
scripts.test:integrations: cd deepseek-harness && corepack pnpm exec vitest run --config ../integrations/cqai-desktop-account/vitest.config.mjs
